text:
kevin: FYI, SkyHarbor (dedicated) reporting they can't access models or billing console after the RBAC role refactor rolled last night.

anna-support: Ugh. Any error messages? Tenant id?

kevin: tenant=skyharbor-prod. Model API returns 403: "access_denied: model.generate". Console shows no models listed. Billing pages 403 too. KMS unwrap shows: "AccessDeniedException: not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-efgh"

anna-support: @simon-eng can you triage? customer is blocked for prod traffic.

simon-eng: looking. quick checklist: role bindings for org scoped roles, service account key perms, KMS key policy. Can you drop the API request id and a sample trace?

kevin: request id: req_0a1b2c3d. paste log snippet: ```stderr
2026-03-18T03:12:04Z model-service error 403 "access_denied: model.generate" tenant=skyharbor-prod principal=svc-sky-models
2026-03-18T03:12:04Z kms-client error AccessDeniedException Not authorized to use key keyId=abcd-efgh
```

maria-sre: I saw a partially applied "role squash" change in the rollout notes yesterday that replaced several org roles with a flattened mapping. Could be a roleshadowing case where org->project bindings were removed.

jessica-privacy: Also check that the KMS key policy wasn't tightened during key rotation. We had a scheduled KMS rotation task for a subset of org keys last night.

simon-eng: Confirmed: our audit logs show role_binding.remove events for principal=svc-sky-models at 02:59:41 UTC from the refactor job. The binding removed grant for role: model.viewer and billing.viewer. That would explain both 403s. KMS logs show Deny because the KMS key policy references the removed service principal.

anna-support: Is there a safe rollback? Customer is blocked from creating embeddings and generating predictions.

simon-eng: I can push an emergency rollback of the role mapping for that org (quick fix) and re-add the service principal to the key policy. Steps: 1) reapply org-level binding for svc-sky-models -> model.viewer, billing.viewer 2) update KMS key policy to include the service principal 3) force token refresh for the service account.

kevin: ETA from customer: immediate, high impact. Please run change as hotfix and ping when done.

simon-eng: Executing step 1 now. apply command: ```bash
redwoodctl rbac apply --org skyharbor-prod --binding '{"principal":"svc-sky-models","roles":["model.viewer","billing.viewer"]}'
```

deploy-bot: change submitted by simon-eng, change-id cfix-20260318-01, starting rollout to control-plane.

simon-eng: Step 1 completed, bindings present. Step 2 updating KMS key policy. Patching key policy to add principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/svc-sky-models.

deploy-bot: kms policy patch applied (change-id cfix-20260318-02).

maria-sre: I see the policy change. Suggest we avoid re-rolling the full role-squash automation until we fix selector logic; looks like it matched service accounts with org-level selectors incorrectly.

kevin: Done rolling back? Customer testing?

anna-support: Hey @kevin customer confirms they can list models and billing pages load. Model generate returns 200 for a small test prompt. KMS decrypt also succeeded.

simon-eng: Good. Final step: force refresh service account tokens so cached credentials no longer fail. Running token rotation for svc-sky-models.

deploy-bot: token rotation job queued and completed (job-id tok-20260318-981).

jessica-privacy: Logging: we should add a note for compliance that keys were modified outside of scheduled rotation window; capturing justification. I'll open the compliance ticket.

maria-sre: I'll block the role-squash rollout and add a regression test to catch org->svc binding removals. Also adding an alert if KMS denies for a recently rotated key and a simultaneous role-binding change occurs.

kevin: Thanks team. Customer escalated to SEs was calmed. Please capture timeline for postmortem.

simon-eng: Opening a short incident: INC-2026-0318-RBAC-KMS. I'll attach audit events and diff for the role-squash job. Assigning follow-ups: ENG-345 fix selector logic, QA-112 add regression, SEC-78 update KMS rotation runbook.

anna-support: Noted. Closing loop with customer and documenting mitigation steps. :white_check_mark:
